description: Runs any of Fuzzframe's actions by name, including ones newer than the tools your chat knows (a chat keeps its own copy of a connector's tools for a while). action "list": every action now, each with what it does and its arguments as JSON Schema. Any other action: the name of one of them (for example "save_look" or "save_voice"), with `args` exactly as its schema says. Use it whenever the guide or the person needs something your own tool list doesn't have; the answer is the same as the tool's own (its card, if it has one, shows only when called as its own tool).

action.description: "list", or an action's name from it

args.description: The action's arguments, as its schema in "list" says

name: fuzzframe_action
title: Run any Fuzzframe action
